purpose: 通过真实鼠标把独立成对鞋拖到完整原人体脚部，验证合法部位、左右脚一起换款、与上装独立、配色细节和整套搭配恢复。

implementation.backend: none; local Three.js, authored geometry, pointer rules and strict state
implementation.shoeRelationship: rigid preadapted complete pairs under the same full avatar root; no feet mask or animated gait
implementation.body: unchanged original complete 53-bone Quaternius CC0 mannequin
implementation.poseLimit: two registered static poses have identical fixed foot locations; no walking
implementation.shoeUpper: Fitting_ShoeUpper recolored; sole, lace, stitching and hardware remain independent
implementation.drop: nearest visible actual avatar or worn mesh hit within bounded foot box
implementation.preview: render-only before a legal release; history retains the complete baseline

state.migration: strict original six fields and four original presets; only version2 and shoes:null are added; old garment, pose, view and exact finite camera retained

passed: Real Court and Ridge meshes dragged to the registered foot region; whole pairs replace atomically.
A single undo restores the prior complete outfit and a single redo restores the replacement.
Real shoe release over the chest or blank space leaves full JSON exactly unchanged.
Escape while a real shoe gesture is active restores full prior JSON before release.
Corrected frozen Ridge held preview captured with dragActive=true/dropValid=true; real release wears the complete pair.
Sidebar Court card physically dragged to feet; one undo restores full prior upper, shoe/color, pose and camera.
Real upper jacket mesh dragged to chest while shoes remain; shoe color changes do not change the upper slot.
All three shoe colors and both registered poses applied; feet stay fixed in both poses.
Removing shoes keeps the upper slot; empty shoe slot disables all three palette buttons; undo restores full JSON.
Native blank-space orbit observes the shoe side/back, changes only camera, and is undoable.
Escape during an active real camera orbit restores the full baseline.
Three legal UI-imported setup fixtures restore exact state and can be undone: strict-v1 jacket migration, v2 shoe-detail and v2 high-precision custom camera.
Eight illegal UI-imported fixtures explicitly rejected, full JSON unchanged: unknown shoe/color, partial pair, cart, size, extra v1 shoe field, new v1 view and over-32KiB.
Final corrected outfit saved and reloaded: upper, shoes/colors, pose, preset and full camera JSON exact.
Final corrected Ridge side/back visually reviewed; former exposed lower-leg triangle eliminated by geometric shaft correction, full original body remains.
Switching upper category while close to feet offers a return-to-overview action; shoe-detail selection opens the shoe controls.

Open ankle portal deliberately remains open. This is not a volumetric collision certificate or real-world sizing/sole-padding simulation.
